outcome: Infant composite adverse outcome (death, severe intraventricular hemorrhage, cystic periventricular leukomalacia, necrotizing enterocolitis, and sepsis before discharge)
cohort: 208 singleton pregnancies with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) occurring between 22 and 33 weeks of gestation in a single tertiary perinatal center between 2009 and 2017
finding: The incidence of UCP among singleton pregnancies with PPROM managed expectantly between 22 and 33 weeks' gestation was 5.8%, and preterm UCP may not be associated with infantile adverse outcomes if emergency cesarean delivery is readily available.
